description: This skill should be used when the user provides a product or topic and wants short-video content scripts. Trigger phrases include '短视频脚本', '分镜头脚本', '口播文案', '抖音脚本', '视频号脚本', '批量生成脚本'. It outputs complete batches of short-video scripts, each with shot breakdown, spoken narration, on-screen captions, hook, and platform-specific pacing notes.
